title: v1.2 A-I3 LLM Runtime Transport Config
description: Connection/runtime details only: which endpoint to reach, which environment variable holds the credential (or null), and the timeout. Must not contain result-affecting generation semantics (temperature, reasoning, prompt version, output-token budget, model). Never includes the credential value itself.

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint prefix. Must be http(s) with a hostname, no embedded credentials, and a path of exactly /v1 (the adapter appends /chat/completions). The schema pins the coarse shape; Python validation is authoritative for a valid port, well-formed IPv6, and no query/fragment.
